    cloud_quota = self.api.cloud_manager.get_cloud_quota()
    provider_resource_limits = self.api.provider_manager.get_provider_resource_limits(provider)
    
    # Calculate usage from other providers on the same endpoint
    other_endpoint_usage = sum(
        self.api.nodes_cache.getQuota(other_provider, include_requested=False)
        for other_provider in self.api.provider_manager.get_providers_on_same_endpoint(provider)
    )
    
    # Calculate usage from the current provider
    this_provider_usage = self.api.nodes_cache.getQuota(provider, include_requested=True)
    
    # Calculate the final limits
    final_limits = min(cloud_quota, provider_resource_limits) - other_endpoint_usage - this_provider_usage
    
    return final_limits
